===== Ofis360/push_delivery.py ===== """Web Push delivery from the existing persistent notification queue.""" import json import os import time from urllib.parse import urlsplit def valid_endpoint(endpoint): try: url=urlsplit(endpoint) host=url.hostname or '' if url.scheme!='https' or url.username or url.password or url.port not in (None,443):return False return host in ('fcm.googleapis.com','updates.push.services.mozilla.com','web.push.apple.com') or host.endswith(('.push.apple.com','.notify.windows.com','.push.services.mozilla.com')) except ValueError:return False def configured(): return all(os.getenv(key) for key in ('OFIS_VAPID_PUBLIC','OFIS_VAPID_PRIVATE','OFIS_VAPID_SUBJECT')) def deliver(connect): if not configured():return from pywebpush import webpush,WebPushException for _ in range(10): now=int(time.time()) with connect() as c: c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE') job=c.execute("""SELECT j.id,j.attempts,s.subscription_json,s.user_id,n.id AS notice FROM push_jobs j JOIN push_subscriptions s ON j.subscription_id=s.id JOIN notifications n ON n.id=j.notification_id JOIN users u ON u.id=n.user_id LEFT JOIN licenses l ON l.tenant=n.business_id WHERE j.status IN ('queued','sending') AND j.next_attempt<=? AND u.active=1 AND s.user_id=n.user_id AND COALESCE(l.state,'active')!='blocked' ORDER BY j.next_attempt,j.id LIMIT 1""",(now,)).fetchone() if not job:return c.execute("UPDATE push_jobs SET status='sending',attempts=attempts+1,next_attempt=? WHERE id=?",(now+120,job['id'])) c.commit() try: sub=json.loads(job['subscription_json']) if not valid_endpoint(sub.get('endpoint','')):raise ValueError('Endpoint') webpush(subscription_info=sub,data=json.dumps(dict(id=job['notice'],title='Ofis360',body='Yeni bir bildiriminiz var.',url='/?ofis_notice='+job['notice'])), vapid_private_key=os.environ['OFIS_VAPID_PRIVATE'],vapid_claims={'sub':os.environ['OFIS_VAPID_SUBJECT']},ttl=3600,timeout=10) status,err='sent','' except Exception as exc: code=exc.response.status_code if isinstance(exc,WebPushException) and exc.response is not None else 0 status='failed' if code in (404,410) or job['attempts']>=4 else 'queued' err=str(code) if code else type(exc).__name__ with connect() as c: c.execute('UPDATE push_jobs SET status=?,last_error=?,next_attempt=? WHERE id=? AND attempts=?',(status,err,now+60*2**job['attempts'],job['id'],job['attempts']+1)) ===== Ofis360/sw.js ===== self.addEventListener('push', event => { let payload={};try{payload=event.data.json()}catch{} event.waitUntil(self.registration.showNotification(payload.title||'Ofis360',{ body:payload.body||'Yeni bildiriminiz var.',tag:payload.id||'ofis360',data:{url:payload.url||'/'} })); }); self.addEventListener('notificationclick', event=>{ event.notification.close(); const url=new URL(event.notification.data?.url||'/',self.location.origin); if(url.origin!==self.location.origin)return; event.waitUntil(clients.matchAll({type:'window',includeUncontrolled:true}).then(async windows=>{ for(const w of windows){if(w.url.startsWith(url.origin)){await w.focus();return w.navigate(url.href)}} return clients.openWindow(url.href); })); }); ===== Ofis360/migrations/001_crm_core.sql ===== -- Aşama 2: müşteri, kurum, adres, yetkili ve cihaz ilişkileri. -- SQLite ve PostgreSQL'de aynı metinle çalışır (database.py INTEGER'ı BIGINT'e çevirir). -- Tüm işlemler IF NOT EXISTS ile tekrar çalıştırılabilir. Eski tablolara dokunulmaz. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customers( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, business_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'individual' CHECK(kind IN ('individual','corporate')), display_name TEXT NOT NULL, first_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', last_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', phone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', phone_raw TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', email TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', name_norm TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', merged_into TEXT REFERENCES customers(id), created_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS customers_phone ON customers(business_id, phone); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS customers_email ON customers(business_id, email); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS customers_name ON customers(business_id, name_norm); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS organizations( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, business_id TEXT NOT NULL, customer_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES customers(id), org_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', tax_office TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', tax_number TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS organizations_tax ON organizations(business_id, tax_number) WHERE tax_number <> ''; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS organization_units( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, business_id TEXT NOT NULL, organization_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id), name TEXT NOT NULL, name_norm TEXT NOT NULL, archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(organization_id, name_norm) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_contacts( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, business_id TEXT NOT NULL, customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id), unit_id TEXT REFERENCES organization_units(id), name TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', phone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', email TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', authorized INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS contacts_customer ON customer_contacts(business_id, customer_id); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_addresses( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, business_id TEXT NOT NULL, customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id), unit_id TEXT REFERENCES organization_units(id), label TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', line TEXT NOT NULL, district TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', city TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', postal_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', latitude DOUBLE PRECISION, longitude DOUBLE PRECISION, is_default INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS addresses_customer ON customer_addresses(business_id, customer_id); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS devices( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, business_id TEXT NOT NULL, customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id), unit_id TEXT REFERENCES organization_units(id), address_id TEXT REFERENCES customer_addresses(id), device_type TEXT NOT NULL, brand TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', serial TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', serial_norm TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', imei TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS devices_customer ON devices(business_id, customer_id); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS devices_serial ON devices(business_id, serial_norm) WHERE serial_norm <> '' AND archived = 0; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_merges( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, business_id TEXT NOT NULL, primary_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id), merged_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id), snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, undone_at TEXT ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS crm_requests( business_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(business_id, request_id) ); ===== Ofis360/baslat.py ===== """Local Windows deployment. All operational files live outside the program folder.""" import os import secrets from pathlib import Path import uvicorn if __name__ == '__main__': root=Path(os.getenv('LOCALAPPDATA',Path.home()))/'GundesliSoft'/'Ofis360' root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True) key_file=root/'master.key' if not os.getenv('OFIS_MASTER_KEY'): try: with key_file.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(secrets.token_urlsafe(36)) except FileExistsError: pass os.environ['OFIS_MASTER_KEY']=key_file.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip() if len(os.environ['OFIS_MASTER_KEY'])<24: raise SystemExit('Platform anahtarı en az 24 karakter olmalı.') os.environ.setdefault('OFIS_DB',str(root/'ofis360.sqlite3')) if all((root/name).is_file() for name in ('vapid-private.pem','vapid-public.txt','vapid-contact.txt')): os.environ.setdefault('OFIS_VAPID_PRIVATE',str(root/'vapid-private.pem')) os.environ.setdefault('OFIS_VAPID_PUBLIC',(root/'vapid-public.txt').read_text().strip()) os.environ.setdefault('OFIS_VAPID_SUBJECT',(root/'vapid-contact.txt').read_text().strip()) print('Ofis360 http://127.0.0.1:8000/') print('Master Admin http://127.0.0.1:8000/master') print('Veritabanı ','PostgreSQL' if os.getenv('OFIS_DATABASE_URL') else os.environ['OFIS_DB']) if key_file.exists(): print('Yerel platform anahtarının dosyası:',key_file) uvicorn.run('server:app',host='127.0.0.1',port=8000) ===== Ofis360/crm.py ===== """Ofis360 müşteri, kurum, adres, yetkili ve cihaz katmanı (v37, Aşama 2). Bu modül FastAPI'den bağımsızdır. Her fonksiyon açık bir veritabanı bağlantısı (`c`) ve oturum sahibi (`a`: id, business_id, role) alır. İşlem sınırını (BEGIN IMMEDIATE / commit) çağıran belirler. Böylece rota katmanı ve testler aynı kodu kullanır. Eski yapıyla ilişki: eski ekranlar müşteriyi `records` (kind='customers') + `record_fields` içinde JSON olarak tutar. Yeni `customers` tablosu aynı kimliği kullanır. Yeni API'den açılan müşteri eski tabloya yansıtılır (mirror_to_legacy), eski ekrandan açılan veya düzenlenen müşteri yeni tablolara aktarılır (sync_from_legacy). Eski satırlar hiçbir zaman silinmez. """ import datetime import difflib import hashlib import json import re import secrets class CrmError(Exception): def __init__(self, status, message, **extra): super().__init__(message) self.status, self.message, self.extra = status, message, extra def now(): return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat() def uid(): return secrets.token_hex(16) def audit(c, a, action, details): c.execute('INSERT INTO audit VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)', (uid(), a['business_id'], a['id'], action, json.dumps(details, ensure_ascii=False), now())) # ---------------------------------------------------------------- normalizasyon _TR = str.maketrans({'İ': 'i', 'I': 'i', 'ı': 'i', 'Ş': 's', 'ş': 's', 'Ğ': 'g', 'ğ': 'g', 'Ü': 'u', 'ü': 'u', 'Ö': 'o', 'ö': 'o', 'Ç': 'c', 'ç': 'c'}) def normalize_name(raw): """Türkçe karakterleri sadeleştirir, noktalamayı atar: 'İbrahim ÇELİK' -> 'ibrahim celik'.""" text = (raw or '').translate(_TR).lower() return ' '.join(re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9 ]', ' ', text).split()) def normalize_phone(raw): """Telefonu +90XXXXXXXXXX biçimine getirir. Boş girdi boş döner, geçersiz girdi 422 verir.""" text = (raw or '').strip() if not text: return '' digits = re.sub(r'\D', '', text) international = text.startswith('+') or digits.startswith('00') if digits.startswith('00'): digits = digits[2:] if international: if digits.startswith('90') and len(digits) == 12: return '+' + digits if 8 <= len(digits) <= 15 and digits[0] != '0': return '+' + digits else: if len(digits) == 12 and digits.startswith('90'): return '+' + digits if len(digits) == 11 and digits.startswith('0'): digits = digits[1:] if len(digits) == 10 and digits[0] in '23458': return '+90' + digits raise CrmError(422, 'Geçerli bir telefon numarası girin') def try_phone(raw): try: return normalize_phone(raw) except CrmError: return '' def normalize_email(raw): text = (raw or '').strip().lower() if text and not re.fullmatch(r'[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+', text): raise CrmError(422, 'Geçerli bir e-posta adresi girin') return text def try_email(raw): try: return normalize_email(raw) except CrmError: return '' def normalize_serial(raw): return re.sub(r'[\s\-]', '', (raw or '')).upper() def clean(value, limit=400): return ' '.join(str(value or '').split())[:limit] def one(c, sql, args=()): return c.execute(sql, args).fetchone() def rows(c, sql, args=()): return [dict(r) for r in c.execute(sql, args).fetchall()] def format_address(row): tail = ' '.join(x for x in (row.get('district', ''), row.get('city', '')) if x) return ', '.join(x for x in (row['line'], tail) if x) # ---------------------------------------------------------------- yardımcı sorgular def customer_row(c, business_id, ident, allow_merged=False): row = one(c, 'SELECT * FROM customers WHERE id=? AND business_id=?', (ident, business_id)) if not row: raise CrmError(404, 'Müşteri bulunamadı') row = dict(row) if row['merged_into'] and not allow_merged: raise CrmError(409, 'Bu müşteri başka bir kayıtla birleştirilmiş', merged_into=row['merged_into']) return row def organization_row(c, customer_id): row = one(c, 'SELECT * FROM organizations WHERE customer_id=?', (customer_id,)) return dict(row) if row else None def unit_for(c, customer, unit_id): """Birim kimliğini doğrular: aynı işletme ve aynı kurum olmalı.""" if not unit_id: return None org = organization_row(c, customer['id']) row = one(c, 'SELECT * FROM organization_units WHERE id=? AND business_id=? AND archived=0', (unit_id, customer['business_id'])) if not row or not org or row['organization_id'] != org['id']: raise CrmError(422, 'Birim bu kuruma ait değil') return dict(row) def address_for(c, customer, address_id): if not address_id: return None row = one(c, 'SELECT * FROM customer_addresses WHERE id=? AND business_id=? AND customer_id=? AND archived=0', (address_id, customer['business_id'], customer['id'])) if not row: raise CrmError(422, 'Adres bu müşteriye ait değil') return dict(row) def ensure_organization(c, customer, org_type='', tax_office='', tax_number=''): org = organization_row(c, customer['id']) if org: return org ident = uid() c.execute('INSERT INTO organizations VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)', (ident, customer['business_id'], customer['id'], org_type, tax_office, tax_number, now())) return dict(one(c, 'SELECT * FROM organizations WHERE id=?', (ident,))) def check_tax_number(c, business_id, tax_number, exclude_customer=None): if not tax_number: return '' digits = re.sub(r'\D', '', tax_number) if len(digits) not in (10, 11): raise CrmError(422, 'Vergi numarası 10 veya 11 haneli olmalı') row = one(c, "SELECT o.customer_id, cu.display_name FROM organizations o JOIN customers cu ON cu.id=o.customer_id " "WHERE o.business_id=? AND o.tax_number=? AND cu.merged_into IS NULL", (business_id, digits)) if row and row['customer_id'] != exclude_customer: raise CrmError(409, 'Bu vergi numarası başka bir kurumda kayıtlı', existing_id=row['customer_id'], existing_name=row['display_name']) return digits # ---------------------------------------------------------------- mükerrer kontrolü def find_duplicates(c, business_id, phone='', email='', name='', exclude_id=None): """Aynı işletmedeki olası mükerrer müşterileri nedenleriyle döndürür.""" phone, email, norm = try_phone(phone), try_email(email), normalize_name(name) found = {} def add(row, reason): if row['id'] == exclude_id: return entry = found.setdefault(row['id'], dict(id=row['id'], display_name=row['display_name'], phone=row['phone'], email=row['email'], reasons=[])) if reason not in entry['reasons']: entry['reasons'].append(reason) base = 'SELECT id,display_name,phone,email,name_norm FROM customers WHERE business_id=? AND merged_into IS NULL AND ' if phone: for r in c.execute(base + 'phone=?', (business_id, phone)).fetchall(): add(r, 'telefon') if email: for r in c.execute(base + 'email=?', (business_id, email)).fetchall(): add(r, 'e-posta') if norm: for r in c.execute(base + 'name_norm=?', (business_id, norm)).fetchall(): add(r, 'aynı ad') if len(norm) >= 4: for r in c.execute(base + 'name_norm LIKE ? AND name_norm<>?', (business_id, norm[:2] + '%', norm)).fetchall(): if difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, norm, r['name_norm']).ratio() >= 0.9: add(r, 'benzer ad') return list(found.values()) # ---------------------------------------------------------------- eski yapıyla eşleme def mirror_to_legacy(c, customer_id): """Yeni tablolardaki müşteri durumunu eski records/record_fields satırına yazar.""" cust = dict(one(c, 'SELECT * FROM customers WHERE id=?', (customer_id,))) existing = one(c, 'SELECT payload FROM record_fields WHERE id=?', (customer_id,)) payload = json.loads(existing['payload']) if existing else {} default = one(c, 'SELECT * FROM customer_addresses WHERE customer_id=? AND archived=0 ' 'ORDER BY is_default DESC, created_at LIMIT 1', (customer_id,)) pairs = rows(c, 'SELECT u.name unit, k.name contact FROM customer_contacts k JOIN organization_units u ON u.id=k.unit_id ' 'WHERE k.customer_id=? AND k.archived=0 AND u.archived=0 ORDER BY u.name, k.name', (customer_id,)) for key, value in (('phone', cust['phone'] or cust['phone_raw']), ('email', cust['email']), ('address', format_address(dict(default)) if default else ''), ('department_contacts', pairs)): if value: payload[key] = value else: payload.pop(key, None) if one(c, "SELECT 1 FROM records WHERE id=? AND kind='customers'", (customer_id,)): c.execute('UPDATE records SET title=? WHERE id=?', (cust['display_name'], customer_id)) else: c.execute('INSERT INTO records VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)', (customer_id, cust['business_id'], 'customers', cust['display_name'], '', '', '', 'Aktif', cust['created_at'])) c.execute('INSERT INTO record_fields VALUES(?,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET payload=excluded.payload', (customer_id, json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False))) def sync_from_legacy(c, business_id, record_id): """Eski ekranda açılan/düzenlenen müşteri kaydını yeni tablolara aktarır. Tekrar çalıştırmak güvenlidir.""" rec = one(c, "SELECT r.id,r.title,r.created,f.payload FROM records r LEFT JOIN record_fields f ON f.id=r.id " "WHERE r.id=? AND r.tenant=? AND r.kind='customers'", (record_id, business_id)) if not rec: return None payload = json.loads(rec['payload'] or '{}') title = clean(rec['title'], 250) or 'Adsız müşteri' phone_raw = clean(payload.get('phone'), 50) phone, email = try_phone(phone_raw), try_email(payload.get('email')) entries = [e for e in payload.get('department_contacts', []) if e.get('unit') and e.get('contact')] stamp = now() cust = one(c, 'SELECT * FROM customers WHERE id=?', (record_id,)) if not cust: parts = title.split() first, last = (' '.join(parts[:-1]), parts[-1]) if len(parts) > 1 and not entries else (title, '') c.execute('INSERT INTO customers(id,business_id,kind,display_name,first_name,last_name,phone,phone_raw,email,' 'name_norm,created_by,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)', (record_id, business_id, 'corporate' if entries else 'individual', title, first, last, phone, '' if phone else phone_raw, email, normalize_name(title), 'legacy', rec['created'] or stamp, stamp)) cust = one(c, 'SELECT * FROM customers WHERE id=?', (record_id,)) else: wanted = (title, phone, '' if phone else phone_raw, email, normalize_name(title)) if wanted != (cust['display_name'], cust['phone'], cust['phone_raw'], cust['email'], cust['name_norm']): c.execute('UPDATE customers SET display_name=?,phone=?,phone_raw=?,email=?,name_norm=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=?', (*wanted, stamp, record_id)) if entries and cust['kind'] == 'individual': c.execute("UPDATE customers SET kind='corporate' WHERE id=?", (record_id,)) cust = one(c, 'SELECT * FROM customers WHERE id=?', (record_id,)) cust = dict(cust) address = clean(payload.get('address'), 400) if address: default = one(c, 'SELECT * FROM customer_addresses WHERE customer_id=? AND archived=0 ' 'ORDER BY is_default DESC, created_at LIMIT 1', (record_id,)) if not default: c.execute('INSERT INTO customer_addresses(id,business_id,customer_id,label,line,is_default,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,1,?)', (uid(), business_id, record_id, 'Ana adres', address, stamp)) elif normalize_name(address) not in (normalize_name(default['line']), normalize_name(format_address(dict(default)))): c.execute("UPDATE customer_addresses SET line=?,district='',city='' WHERE id=?", (address, default['id'])) if entries or cust['kind'] == 'corporate': org = ensure_organization(c, cust) for entry in entries: unit_name = clean(entry['unit'], 160) unit = one(c, 'SELECT id FROM organization_units WHERE organization_id=? AND name_norm=?', (org['id'], normalize_name(unit_name))) unit_id = unit['id'] if unit else uid() if not unit: c.execute('INSERT INTO organization_units VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,0,?)', (unit_id, business_id, org['id'], unit_name, normalize_name(unit_name), stamp)) contact_name = clean(entry['contact'], 160) if not one(c, 'SELECT 1 FROM customer_contacts WHERE customer_id=? AND unit_id=? AND name=?', (record_id, unit_id, contact_name)): c.execute('INSERT INTO customer_contacts(id,business_id,customer_id,unit_id,name,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)', (uid(), business_id, record_id, unit_id, contact_name, stamp)) return record_id def backfill_legacy_customers(c): """Henüz yeni tabloya geçmemiş tüm eski müşteri kayıtlarını aktarır. Kaç kayıt aktarıldığını döndürür.""" pending = c.execute("SELECT id,tenant FROM records WHERE kind='customers' AND id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM customers)").fetchall() for r in pending: sync_from_legacy(c, r['tenant'], r['id']) return len(pending) # ---------------------------------------------------------------- müşteri def fingerprint(payload): return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, default=str).encode()).hexdigest() def create_customer(c, a, data, request_id='', allow_duplicate=False): """Yeni müşteri açar. request_id aynıysa ikinci istek yeni kayıt açmaz, ilk sonucu döndürür.""" bid = a['business_id'] digest = fingerprint(data) if request_id: prior = one(c, 'SELECT fingerprint,result FROM crm_requests WHERE business_id=? AND request_id=?', (bid, request_id)) if prior: if prior['fingerprint'] != digest: raise CrmError(409, 'Bu istek kimliği farklı bir içerikle kullanılmış') return json.loads(prior['result']) kind = data.get('kind') or 'individual' if kind not in ('individual', 'corporate'): raise CrmError(422, 'Geçersiz müşteri türü') first, last = clean(data.get('first_name'), 100), clean(data.get('last_name'), 100) if kind == 'corporate': display = clean(data.get('organization_name'), 250) if not display: raise CrmError(422, 'Kurum adı gerekli') first = last = '' else: display = ' '.join(x for x in (first, last) if x) if not first: raise CrmError(422, 'Ad gerekli') phone_raw = clean(data.get('phone'), 50) phone, email = normalize_phone(phone_raw), normalize_email(data.get('email')) tax = check_tax_number(c, bid, data.get('tax_number', '')) if kind == 'corporate' else '' duplicates = find_duplicates(c, bid, phone, email, display) if duplicates and not allow_duplicate: raise CrmError(409, 'Olası mükerrer müşteri kaydı bulundu', duplicates=duplicates) ident, stamp = uid(), now() c.execute('INSERT INTO customers(id,business_id,kind,display_name,first_name,last_name,phone,email,name_norm,notes,' 'created_by,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)', (ident, bid, kind, display, first, last, phone, email, normalize_name(display), clean(data.get('notes'), 2000), a['id'], stamp, stamp)) customer = customer_row(c, bid, ident) if kind == 'corporate': ensure_organization(c, customer, clean(data.get('org_type'), 80), clean(data.get('tax_office'), 120), tax) if data.get('address'): add_address(c, a, ident, dict(data['address'], is_default=True), _mirror=False) mirror_to_legacy(c, ident) audit(c, a, 'customer_created', dict(id=ident, kind=kind, duplicate_override=bool(duplicates))) result = {'id': ident} if request_id: c.execute('INSERT INTO crm_requests VALUES(?,?,?,?)', (bid, request_id, digest, json.dumps(result))) return result def update_customer(c, a, ident, data): bid = a['business_id'] cust = customer_row(c, bid, ident) changes = {} if cust['kind'] == 'corporate': if 'organization_name' in data and data['organization_name'] is not None: name = clean(data['organization_name'], 250) if not name: raise CrmError(422, 'Kurum adı gerekli') changes.update(display_name=name, name_norm=normalize_name(name)) else: first = clean(data['first_name'], 100) if data.get('first_name') is not None else cust['first_name'] last = clean(data['last_name'], 100) if data.get('last_name') is not None else cust['last_name'] if not first: raise CrmError(422, 'Ad gerekli') name = ' '.join(x for x in (first, last) if x) changes.update(first_name=first, last_name=last, display_name=name, name_norm=normalize_name(name)) if data.get('phone') is not None: changes.update(phone=normalize_phone(data['phone']), phone_raw='') if data.get('email') is not None: changes['email'] = normalize_email(data['email']) if data.get('notes') is not None: changes['notes'] = clean(data['notes'], 2000) if cust['kind'] == 'corporate' and any(data.get(k) is not None for k in ('org_type', 'tax_office', 'tax_number')): org = ensure_organization(c, cust) tax = check_tax_number(c, bid, data['tax_number'], ident) if data.get('tax_number') is not None else org['tax_number'] c.execute('UPDATE organizations SET org_type=?,tax_office=?,tax_number=? AND archived=0 ORDER BY name', (ident,)) cust['addresses'] = rows(c, 'SELECT * FROM customer_addresses WHERE customer_id=? AND archived=0 ' 'ORDER BY is_default DESC, created_at', (ident,)) cust['devices'] = rows(c, 'SELECT * FROM devices WHERE customer_id=? AND archived=0', (now(), ident, a['business_id'])).rowcount: raise CrmError(404, 'Cihaz bulunamadı') audit(c, a, 'device_archived', dict(id=ident)) return {'ok': True} def find_devices(c, business_id, serial='', customer_id=''): where, args = ['d.business_id=?', 'd.archived=0'], [business_id] if serial: where.append('d.serial_norm=?') args.append(normalize_serial(serial)) if customer_id: where.append('d.customer_id=?') args.append(customer_id) return rows(c, 'SELECT d.*,cu.display_name customer_name FROM devices d JOIN customers cu ON cu.id=d.customer_id WHERE ' + ' AND '.join(where) + ' ORDER BY d.created_at DESC LIMIT 200', args) # ---------------------------------------------------------------- birleştirme def _legacy_record_ids(c, business_id, customer_id): """customer_id'yi JSON içinde taşıyan eski servis/saha kayıtlarını bulur.""" found = [] for r in c.execute("SELECT r.id,f.payload FROM records r JOIN record_fields f ON f.id=r.id " "WHERE r.tenant=? AND r.kind<>'customers' AND f.payload LIKE ?", (business_id, f'%{customer_id}%')).fetchall(): if json.loads(r['payload']).get('customer_id') == customer_id: found.append(r['id']) return found def _repoint_legacy(c, ids, old, new): for ident in ids: r = one(c, 'SELECT payload FROM record_fields WHERE id=?', (ident,)) payload = json.loads(r['payload']) if payload.get('customer_id') == old: payload['customer_id'] = new c.execute('UPDATE record_fields SET payload=? AND name_norm=?', (p_org['id'], unit['name_norm'])) if twin: snap['unit_map'][unit['id']] = twin['id'] else: c.execute('UPDATE organization_units SET organization_id=? WHERE id=?', (p_org['id'], unit['id'])) snap['units'].append(unit['id']) unit_map = snap['unit_map'] for table, key in (('customer_addresses', 'addresses'), ('customer_contacts', 'contacts'), ('devices', 'devices')): for row in rows(c, f'SELECT id,unit_id{",is_default" if table == "customer_addresses" else ""} FROM {table} WHERE customer_id=?', (merged_id,)): snap[key].append([row['id'], row['unit_id'], row.get('is_default', 0)]) sets, args = 'customer_id=?', [primary_id] if row['unit_id'] in unit_map: sets += ',unit_id=?' args.append(unit_map[row['unit_id']]) if table == 'customer_addresses': sets += ',is_default=0' c.execute(f'UPDATE {table} SET {sets} WHERE id=?', (*args, row['id'])) snap['records'] = _legacy_record_ids(c, bid, merged_id) _repoint_legacy(c, snap['records'], merged_id, primary_id) snap['sales'] = [r['id'] for r in c.execute('SELECT id FROM sales WHERE business_id=? AND customer_id=?', (bid, merged_id)).fetchall()] snap['debts'] = [r['id'] for r in c.execute('SELECT id FROM debts WHERE business_id=? AND customer_id=?', (bid, merged_id)).fetchall()] for table, ids in (('sales', snap['sales']), ('debts', snap['debts'])): for ident in ids: c.execute(f'UPDATE {table} SET customer_id=? WHERE id=?', (primary_id, ident)) for field in ('phone', 'email'): if not primary[field] and merged[field]: c.execute(f'UPDATE customers SET {field}=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=?', (merged[field], now(), primary_id)) snap['filled'][field] = merged[field] c.execute('UPDATE customers SET merged_into=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=?', (primary_id, now(), merged_id)) mid = uid() c.execute('INSERT INTO customer_merges VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,NULL)', (mid, bid, primary_id, merged_id, json.dumps(snap), clean(reason, 400), a['id'], now())) mirror_to_legacy(c, primary_id) audit(c, a, 'customers_merged', dict(merge=mid, primary=primary_id, merged=merged_id)) return {'id': mid, 'moved': {k: len(snap[k]) for k in ('addresses', 'contacts', 'devices', 'records', 'sales', 'debts')}} def undo_merge(c, a, merge_id): bid = a['business_id'] m = one(c, 'SELECT * FROM customer_merges WHERE id=? AND business_id=?', (merge_id, bid)) if not m: raise CrmError(404, 'Birleştirme kaydı bulunamadı') if m['undone_at']: raise CrmError(409, 'Bu birleştirme zaten geri alınmış') primary = customer_row(c, bid, m['primary_id'], allow_merged=True) if primary['merged_into']: raise CrmError(409, 'Ana kayıt sonradan başka bir kayıtla birleştirilmiş. AND customer_id=?', (*args, ident, m['primary_id'])) m_org = organization_row(c, m['merged_id']) for unit_id in snap['units']: c.execute('UPDATE organization_units SET organization_id=? WHERE id=?', (m_org['id'], unit_id)) _repoint_legacy(c, snap['records'], m['primary_id'], m['merged_id']) for table, key in (('sales', 'sales'), ('debts', 'debts')): for ident in snap[key]: c.execute(f'UPDATE {table} SET customer_id=? WHERE id=? AND customer_id=?', (m['merged_id'], ident, m['primary_id'])) for field, value in snap['filled'].items(): c.execute(f'UPDATE customers SET {field}=? WHERE id=? AND {field}=?', ('', m['primary_id'], value)) c.execute('UPDATE customers SET merged_into=NULL,updated_at=? WHERE id=?', (now(), m['merged_id'])) c.execute('UPDATE customer_merges SET undone_at=? WHERE id=?', (now(), merge_id)) mirror_to_legacy(c, m['primary_id']) mirror_to_legacy(c, m['merged_id']) audit(c, a, 'customers_unmerged', dict(merge=merge_id)) return {'ok': True} def list_merges(c, business_id): return rows(c, 'SELECT id,primary_id,merged_id,reason,actor_id,created_at,undone_at FROM customer_merges ' 'WHERE business_id=? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200', (business_id,)) ===== Ofis360/configure_push.py ===== """Generate a per-installation VAPID key pair. Never print the private key.""" import argparse import base64 from pathlib import Path from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import ec def setup(root, contact): if not contact.startswith('mailto:') or '@' not in contact or '\n' in contact: raise ValueError('mailto: ile başlayan bir iletişim adresi girin.') root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True) private = root/'vapid-private.pem' if not private.exists(): key=ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1()) with private.open('xb') as f: f.write(key.private_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM,serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8,serialization.NoEncryption())) private.chmod(0o600) key=serialization.load_pem_private_key(private.read_bytes(),password=None) public=key.public_key().public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.X962,serialization.PublicFormat.UncompressedPoint) (root/'vapid-public.txt').write_text(base64.urlsafe_b64encode(public).rstrip(b'=').decode(),encoding='ascii') (root/'vapid-contact.txt').write_text(contact,encoding='utf-8') if __name__=='__main__': import os parser=argparse.ArgumentParser() parser.add_argument('contact') args=parser.parse_args() setup(Path(os.getenv('LOCALAPPDATA',Path.home()))/'GundesliSoft'/'Ofis360',args.contact) print('Bildirim anahtarları hazır. BASLAT.cmd ile sunucuyu yeniden başlatın.') ===== Ofis360/planning.py ===== """Prepare field schedules. A proposal never assigns or notifies an employee.""" import datetime as dt import json def minutes(value): hour, minute = map(int, value.split(':')) return hour * 60 + minute def propose(c, tenant, day, config): opening, closing = map(minutes,(config['opens'],config['closes'])) staff = [p['id'] for p in c.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE business_id=? AND active=1 AND role='field' ORDER BY name,id",(tenant,))] records = list(c.execute("SELECT r.*,f.payload FROM records r JOIN record_fields f ON r.id=f.id WHERE tenant=? AND kind='field' AND status NOT IN ('Tamamlandı','İptal') ORDER BY created,id",(tenant,))) bookings, waiting = [], [] for row in records: f = json.loads(row['payload']) if not row['assignee'] and (not row['due'] or row['due']<=day): waiting.append((row,f)) elif row['due']==day: try:start=minutes(f['appointment_time']) except (ValueError,KeyError):start=opening end=start+f.get('duration',60) if f.get('appointment_time') else closing bookings.append((start,end,{row['assignee'],f.get('colleague','')},f.get('vehicle',''))) suggestions=[] for row,f in sorted(waiting,key=lambda item:({'Acil':0,'Yüksek':1}.get(item[1].get('priority'),2),item[1].get('address',''),item[0]['created'])): duration=f.get('duration',60) vehicle=f.get('vehicle','') skill=f.get('skill','').strip().casefold() specialties=config.get('specialties',{}) for start in range(opening,closing-duration+1,15): end=start+duration busy=[b for b in bookings if b[0]Gündeşli Soft · Master Admin

===== Ofis360/server.py ===== """Ofis360 server foundation. Run with uvicorn server:app --reload. Requires HTTPS in production, PostgreSQL recommended for multi-worker deployments. """ import os, sqlite3, json, time, secrets, hashlib, hmac, datetime from database import connect, IntegrityError import crm from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Header, Request from fastapi.responses import FileResponse, HTMLResponse from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from pathlib import Path from typing import Literal from pydantic import BaseModel, Field DB=os.getenv('OFIS_DATABASE_URL') or os.getenv('OFIS_DB','ofis360.sqlite3') app=FastAPI(title='Gündeşli Soft Ofis360 API') def conn(): return connect(DB) @app.on_event('startup') def init(): with conn() as c: c.executescript('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,business_id TEXT NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,email TEXT NOT NULL,password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,role TEXT NOT NULL,active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,UNIQUE(business_id,email)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions(token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),expires INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,business_id TEXT NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,stock INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(stock>=0),price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,business_id TEXT NOT NULL,customer_id TEXT,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,total_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sale_lines(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,sale_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales(id),product_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id),qty INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(qty>0),price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS debts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,business_id TEXT NOT NULL,sale_id TEXT REFERENCES sales(id),customer_id TEXT NOT NULL,amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents>=0),due_at TEXT,reason TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS collections(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,debt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES debts(id),business_id TEXT NOT NULL,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents>0),created_at TEXT NOT NULL,voided INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_moves(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,business_id TEXT NOT NULL,product_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id),qty_delta INTEGER NOT NULL,source_type TEXT NOT NULL,source_id TEXT NOT NULL,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notifications(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,business_id TEXT NOT NULL,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),title TEXT NOT NULL,body TEXT NOT NULL,target TEXT,read_at TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(user_id,target,title)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS push_subscriptions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),endpoint TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,subscription_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS push_jobs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,notification_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notifications(id),subscription_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES push_subscriptions(id),attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,next_attempt INTEGER DEFAULT 0,status TEXT DEFAULT 'queued',last_error TEXT, UNIQUE(notification_id,subscription_id));
